LanguageData.TraderShipsCrash:
A trade ship previously known as {0} has crashed nearby.

They were a {1}.

Some of their stock is scattered around.
LanguageData.TraderShipsLeavingDueToDamage: {0} is leaving because of damage to the ship.
LanguageData.TraderShipsDisableOrbitalDesc: Prevent orbital traders from appearing (trade ships will still come as long as this mod is active).
LanguageData.TraderShipsColorsDesc: Allow ships to have different colors.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequireCommssConsoleDesc: Ships won't come unless you have a comms console.
LanguageData.TraderShipsSaturationDesc: Generated ships will have HSV color with saturation in specified range (also bound by [0,100]).
LanguageData.TraderShipsValueDesc: Generated ships will have HSV color with value in specified range (also bound by [0,100])
LanguageData.TraderShipsLandingZoneExpandDesc: Create an area that will be preferred as a landing zone by space ships. A ship will try to land in the middle of a landing zone, so if you want a large landing pad with multiple ships on it, designate multiple non-intersecting zones.
LanguageData.TraderShipsLandingZoneClearDesc: Remove landing zone area, making space ships choose where to land themselves.
LanguageData.TraderShipsLandingZoneBlocked: Space ship could not land on landing zone: {0}.
LanguageData.TraderShipsDebugOutOfBounds: Click inside the map to spawn a trade ship.
LanguageData.TraderShipsEnableShipRequestDesc: Adds a "Request trade ship" option to the comms console faction dialog. Pay silver to charter a ship of your chosen kind instead of waiting for the random event. Requires an ally faction.
LanguageData.TraderShipsShipRequestCostDesc: How much silver a chartered trade ship costs. The payment is taken from the colony once the ship has arrived.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipCooldown: You must wait {0} before requesting another trade ship.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipLowSilver: You need {COST} silver to charter a trade ship.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipPickKind: Which kind of ship should {FACTION} send?
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipFailed: No trade ship could be dispatched right now.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipArrived: A {KIND} has arrived. Charter fee: {COST} silver.
LanguageData.TraderShipsShipRequestAllyDesc: When off, neutral factions will also charter a ship for silver. Hostile factions never will.
LanguageData.TraderShipsArrivalIntervalDesc: Random trade ships will not arrive more often than this. 0 leaves the vanilla storyteller cadence untouched. Paid requests are not affected.
LanguageData.TraderShipsStayDaysDesc: How long a landed trade ship waits before leaving. Vanilla uses about 0.67 days, which is short for a ship your pawns have to walk to.
LanguageData.TraderShipsMaxShipsDesc: Landed ships occupy real map space and all aim for the same landing zone, so this keeps them from piling up. Paid requests respect this limit too.
LanguageData.TraderShipsBakeGraphicsDesc: Combines each ship's parts into one texture so it costs a single draw call instead of one per part. Turn this off if ships look wrong; the old per-part drawing path is kept as a fallback.
LanguageData.TraderShipsShipDamagedText: {SHIP} has taken heavy fire and is about to lift off. The captain demands {COST} silver in compensation on behalf of {FACTION}.
LanguageData.TraderShipsShipDeclareHostileOption: Refuse and accept the consequences (declares hostility)
LanguageData.TraderShipsShipCompensated: Paid {COST} silver in compensation. The ship lifts off.
LanguageData.TraderShipsShipDestroyedHostile: You destroyed the trader ship. {FACTION} is now hostile.
LanguageData.TraderShipsStowawayChanceDesc: Chance that a landed ship drops off a stowaway. 0 disables it.
LanguageData.TraderShipsStowawayStayDesc: How long a stowaway stays before walking off the map.
LanguageData.TraderShipsStowawayArrived: {PAWN} slipped off a trade ship and joined the colony for {DAYS} days.
LanguageData.TraderShipsBuyShipAlreadyOwn: You already own a trade ship.
LanguageData.TraderShipsBuyShipDone: You bought a trade ship for {PRICE} silver. Load it and launch it to trade elsewhere.
LanguageData.TraderShipsBuyShipNoRoom: There is no room to park your new ship.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestCooldownDesc: How long you must wait before calling another ship from the same faction. 0 removes the cooldown.
LanguageData.TraderShipsBuyShipNoSeller: No ship from this faction is currently docked.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipNoKinds: This faction has no ship type it can send.
LanguageData.TraderShipsStowawayLetterText: {PAWN} slipped off a trade ship and is now wandering near your colony. With no faction and nowhere to go, {PAWN} will join the colony if taken in, and leave within {DAYS} days if turned away.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoFactionShipsDesc: Automatically create a trade ship for each faction, stocking items from the same mod that defines the faction. Takes effect on the next game start.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying goods made by their people.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipHostile: This faction is hostile and will not send ships.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Medical: A trade ship sent by {0}, stocked with medicine and drugs.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Weapon: A trade ship sent by {0}, stocked with weapons.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Apparel: A trade ship sent by {0}, stocked with clothing and armor.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Slave: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying batches of slaves.
LanguageData.TraderShipsDispatchPickFaction: Select a faction on the left.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_General: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying their local goods.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Food: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying meals, drinks and spices.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Resource: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying metal, leather and textiles.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Industrial: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying components, fuel and chemicals.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Furniture: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying furniture and building materials.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Exotic: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying artifacts, relics and ultratech.
LanguageData.TraderShipsAutoKindDesc_Talent: A trade ship sent by {0}, carrying highly skilled people.
LanguageData.TraderShipsGoodwillLost: You refused to compensate the damaged trade ship. Relations with {FACTION} worsened by {DELTA}.
LanguageData.TraderShipsGoodwillAlreadyLow: You refused to compensate the damaged trade ship. Relations with {FACTION} cannot get any worse.
LanguageData.TraderShipsRequestShipUnderpaid: The charter fee was only covered for {PAID} of {COST} silver; the shortfall was written off.
LanguageData.TraderShipsBuyShipFailed: The ship could not be created. You have been fully refunded.
